urs-vex-ebm.line: Glass-box models over VEX robotics telemetry
urs-vex-ebm.blurb: Glass-box explainable boosting models over VEX robotics telemetry, predicting learner outcomes from behaviour traces rather than from a black box.

brain-encoder-audit.line: Do the features it is credited with actually reach the prediction?
brain-encoder-audit.blurb: Information-flow audit of a multimodal brain encoder: minimal pairs and LEACE concept erasure to test whether the features it is credited with using actually reach the prediction.

InviteInstitute/lm-dashboard.line: Realtime learning analytics for AI tutors

InviteInstitute/vex-agent-integration.line: Robotics triggers wired to a pedagogical agent
InviteInstitute/vex-agent-integration.blurb: Connects VEX robotics triggers and episodes to a pedagogical agent, evaluating behavioral rules against live data on a 5 second cycle.

InviteInstitute/agent-lm-packages.line: VEX log parser and learner models
InviteInstitute/agent-lm-packages.blurb: VEX log parser and learner models built for the Shan and Noah study.

firewatch.blurb: Wildfire severity forecasting 52 weeks out, merging 3 federal datasets and 11K+ fire observations. Led 4 developers across 10 sprints.

Maharsh17/county-clustering.line: 3,128 US counties grouped by mobility and vulnerability
Maharsh17/county-clustering.blurb: Groups 3,128 US counties by social vulnerability and upward mobility, then tests whether the groups are real or an artifact of what was measured.
